rationale: The assistant correctly recognised a TV as outside its nine-family scope, declined without inventing anything, and gave the right pointer ('manufacturer's support line or a specialist electronics repairer') plus the appropriate safety boundary ('please don't open the case, as the power supply inside can hold a dangerous charge'). It asked no questions and offered none of the optional simple checks (source, power reset, torch test) the ground truth lists as acceptable, so diagnostic value is limited, but the decline is accurate, safe and proportionate. A UK homeowner would be sent in the right direction, if a little briefly.
